subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 terms for EmberTech (discount & retainer credit)
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@embertech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@embertech.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: billing cadence + net-60 for Redwood engagement

Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. EmberTech is ready to move forward on the 200k TCV pilot, but procurement has requested two billing changes to align with our internal cadence:

- Quarterly invoicing (one invoice per quarter, forecasted amounts)
- Net-60 payment terms instead of standard Net-30

To make this work on our side we discussed a one-time retainer credit (to be applied to the first invoice) and a small committed-volume discount. I've attached our proposed schedule and a draft SOW for your review.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate these terms and, if so, whether any executive approval is required? Procurement is pushing for a decision by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Head of Procurement, EmberTech
Attachment: EmberTech_SOW_Q4.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: ember_payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: billing cadence + net-60 for Redwood engagement

Folks — forwarding EmberTech's ask. Key points: 200k pilot, they'd like quarterly invoices + Net-60, offering a $30k retainer credit applied to Q1 and asking for a 4% committed-volume discount. Procurement needs a yes/no by Friday.

Recommendation: Approve Net-60 for first two quarters and quarterly invoicing for the pilot only; apply the $30k credit against the first invoice; accept a 3% discount (compromise) if we tie the credit to signed SOW and milestone payments.

Questions for Deal Desk / Finance:
- Is Net-60 exposure acceptable for 200k TCV?
- Are there accounting or revenue recognition notes we need to tie to the credit?

I'm happy to take this up to ops/finance if you think we need exec sign-off.

—Jordan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: billing cadence + net-60 for Redwood engagement

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for flagging. A few quick items from finance:

1) Net-60 on a 200k pilot increases DSO risk; acceptable if we get a $30k retainer that is non-refundable and recognized against the first invoice. We need the retainer contractually classified as a one-time prepayment.

2) Quarterly invoicing is operationally fine, but the invoice must include a clear payment schedule and line items to make collections predictable. We should avoid open-ended quarterly estimates; prefer fixed forecast with variance reconciliation.

3) Discount: 4% feels high for this scope. Propose 2–3% max and require that the discount is gated on timely payment (e.g., discount only if previous invoice paid within Net-30).

Next steps: Can legal produce a short amendment to the SOW that: (a) records the $30k retainer as prepayment, (b) specifies quarterly invoicing cadence & fixed forecast amounts, and (c) limits the discount to a conditional, payment-linked clause? If so, finance can authorize Net-60 for the pilot period.

Rishi
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: billing cadence + net-60 for Redwood engagement

Rishi — appreciate the guidance. A few clarifying points from the AE side after a sync with EmberTech:

- Ember's procurement confirmed the $30k credit is effectively a prepayment they expect applied to Q1; they don't want it refundable.
- The quarterly forecast is tidy: Q1 50k, Q2 75k, Q3 75k for the pilot period. They want a clean single invoice each quarter for those amounts.
- Ember is sensitive to cash timing — Net-60 is non-negotiable on their side because of internal payroll cycles.

I propose we accept the conditional approach: Net-60 for the pilot only (first two quarters) provided we: (1) get the $30k as prepayment and (2) implement the payment-linked discount (3% if prior invoice paid Net-30; otherwise no discount). We will require DocuSign on the SOW amendment.

If legal can route a short amendment today I can push Ember's procurement to sign before EOD Friday. DocuSign link to be used: https://app.docusign.com/doc/XYZ-EMB-4872

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: EmberTech Net-60 + quarterly invoices (EMB-4872)

Aditya / Rishi —

I need a quick exec sign-off to close EmberTech this week. Summary of recommended terms: 
- Pilot TCV: $200,000 (50/75/75 quarterly forecast)
- Quarterly invoicing for pilot only (fixed amounts per quarter)
- Net-60 for first two quarters only
- One-time $30,000 prepayment applied to Q1 invoice (non-refundable)
- Conditional discount: 3% applied only if prior invoice paid within Net-30

Risk mitigations: prepayment reduces open exposure; discount is conditional; revert to standard Net-30 after pilot. Legal will include three-line SOW amendment to capture these points and provide DocuSign. EmberTech needs confirmation by EOD Friday to meet their procurement window.

Can I please get thumbs-up from finance/ops or direct me to escalate?

—Jordan
Senior AE
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: EmberTech Net-60 + quarterly invoices (EMB-4872)

Jordan / Aditya — approved with conditions below. Please proceed to finalize and get DocuSign signed by procurement.

Conditions of approval:
1) The $30k must be recorded as a non-refundable prepayment in the SOW amendment.
2) Quarterly invoices must include a payment schedule line item and a reconciliation clause for any variance.
3) The 3% discount is only applied retroactively if the customer pays the previous invoice within Net-30; otherwise discount for that invoice is void.
4) Finance will place the customer on a collections watchlist; failure to meet payment obligations will trigger immediate contract reversion to Net-30 and suspension of any future credits/discounts.

Once Legal routes the amendment, Marissa please push the DocuSign and confirm receipt of the prepayment. Jordan — if EmberTech insists on Net-60 beyond the two pilot quarters, escalate back to me.

Rishi
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
